AccountDetailsResponse.title: AccountDetailsResponse
AccountDetailsResponse.description:
An account as its owner reads it: secret credentials are only declared present, never returned (R0.2.3); the
public fields the exchange declares are shown by name (Bug 401).

AccountReconciliationResponse.title: AccountReconciliationResponse
AccountReconciliationResponse.description: Whether the balance of the account is the expected one: aligned without an open alarm (R3.3.1).

AccountScope.title: AccountScope
AccountScope.description: Which rows of an account to read: those of no flow only, or all of them, of every flow and of none.

AccountStateResponse.title: AccountStateResponse
AccountStateResponse.description: The state of an account read from the exchange at the request (R0.2.2): the same body from worker and API.

AccountSummaryResponse.title: AccountSummaryResponse
AccountSummaryResponse.description:
An account in the list of its owner (R2.2.1, ADR 0126): network and capital its flows hold, never the balance,
which the exchange gives at /accounts/{id}/state; the expiry of its credentials as of today, with its state
(`unknown`, `valid`, `expiring` within 30 days, `expired`) and the days left, and whether the user may give it
(R6.2.2).

AlertDetailResponse.title: AlertDetailResponse
AlertDetailResponse.description: The alert with the values read when it opened and the commands that resolve it now; none once resolved.

AlertKind.title: AlertKind
AlertKind.description:
A fact that asks the user to act, with its severity and how it resolves (R6.2.3, ADR
avvisi-nel-contesto-delle-notifiche): only a kind without a resolution of its own is resolved by hand.

AlertPageResponse.title: AlertPageResponse
AlertPageResponse.description:
At most 50 alerts, newest first; `next` is the `cursor` of the following page, null on the last one. `count`
covers every alert of the filter, not only the page.

AlertRemedy.title: AlertRemedy
AlertRemedy.description: What removes the cause of an open alert, or resolves it when nothing else does (R6.2.3).

AlertResourceKind.title: AlertResourceKind
AlertResourceKind.description: What an alert is about: an account, a flow or a key (R6.2.3).

AlertResponse.title: AlertResponse
AlertResponse.description: An alert of the tenant: what asks to act, how serious it is, on which resource, and whether it is resolved.

AlertStateQuery.title: AlertStateQuery
AlertStateQuery.description: The state the list asks for: `all` does not narrow.

BalanceComparisonResponse.title: BalanceComparisonResponse
BalanceComparisonResponse.description: The last comparison of the balance of the account; amounts as strings (ADR 0018).

CapitalChangePageResponse.title: CapitalChangePageResponse
CapitalChangePageResponse.description: A page of the history of the capital, from the most recent row, with how many rows the period holds (R3.4.2).

CapitalChangeResponse.title: CapitalChangeResponse
CapitalChangeResponse.description:
A row of the history of the capital (R3.4.2): a deposit or a withdrawal of the account has no flow and no capital
before and after.

CashOutOutcomeResponse.title: CashOutOutcomeResponse
CashOutOutcomeResponse.description:
The flow after the cash-out, the money it freed and the positions not closed, each with its reason (R3.4.1).

With a position left open nothing is freed.

CashOutRequest.title: CashOutRequest
CashOutRequest.description: The capital the flow keeps after the cash-out; without it, the capital allocated now (R3.4.1).

ChannelChoiceRequest.title: ChannelChoiceRequest
ChannelChoiceRequest.description: The channels of a type of event for all the flows of the user, none for no notification.

ChannelStateResponse.title: ChannelStateResponse
ChannelStateResponse.description: A channel of the platform, whether the user configured it, and otherwise what it misses (R3.5.5).

ClosedPositionPageResponse.title: ClosedPositionPageResponse
ClosedPositionPageResponse.description:
A page of the closed positions of a flow that match the filters, from the most recent close, with how many
match in all (R1.7.2, R2.2.5, R6.4.4).

ClosedPositionResponse.title: ClosedPositionResponse
ClosedPositionResponse.description: A closed position of a flow with its result (R1.7.2); amounts as text without trailing zeros (ADR 0018).

ClosedPositionTotalsResponse.title: ClosedPositionTotalsResponse
ClosedPositionTotalsResponse.description: The PnL and the fees of every closed position of the filters, not only of the page (Bug 569).

ConfigurationResponse.title: ConfigurationResponse
ConfigurationResponse.description: One configuration version of a flow.

CycleDetailResponse.title: CycleDetailResponse
CycleDetailResponse.description: A cycle with everything recorded about it, and what started it (R1.7.1, R6.5.2).

CyclePageResponse.title: CyclePageResponse
CyclePageResponse.description: A page of the cycles that match the filters, with how many match in all (R1.7.3, R6.4.4).

CycleSummaryResponse.title: CycleSummaryResponse
CycleSummaryResponse.description:
A cycle in the list: its instants, its outcome, the decisions of the agent and what started it (R1.7.3,
R6.5.2).

DatedDecisionResponse.title: DatedDecisionResponse
DatedDecisionResponse.description: A decision of the history with the planned instant of its cycle, which leads to its detail (R6.5.5).

DecisionPageResponse.title: DecisionPageResponse
DecisionPageResponse.description:
A page of the decisions that match the filters in the period, with how many match in all (ADR
storico-delle-decisioni-nell-api).

DecisionResponse.title: DecisionResponse
DecisionResponse.description:
A decision of the agent on one asset: the direction only for an opening, the confidence null when the agent
gave none (R6.5.4).

DefaultSystemPromptResponse.title: DefaultSystemPromptResponse
DefaultSystemPromptResponse.description: The system prompt a new flow starts with, and the placeholders it may use (R1.4.8).

DeviationThresholdRequest.title: DeviationThresholdRequest
DeviationThresholdRequest.description: The threshold of the balance deviation of the account, in percent of the expected balance (R3.3.1).

EmergencyClosingPreviewResponse.title: EmergencyClosingPreviewResponse
EmergencyClosingPreviewResponse.description:
The flows of the scope and the positions they hold now, for the confirmation (ADR chiusura-di-emergenza-nella-
dashboard).

EmergencyClosingRequest.title: EmergencyClosingRequest
EmergencyClosingRequest.description: A flow, an account, or neither for every flow of the user (R3.2.3).

EquityPointResponse.title: EquityPointResponse
EquityPointResponse.description:
A point of the curve: its equity and how much it moved from the first point of the period, in percent with two
decimals, null when the first point has no equity (ADR 0137).

EventChannelResponse.title: EventChannelResponse
EventChannelResponse.description:
A type of event by the name the user reads, its channels, whether a flow may have an exception for it, and
the warnings of a chosen channel that is not linked (R3.5.3).

ExpirySource.title: ExpirySource
ExpirySource.description: Who gave the day a key stops working, the same names for every key (R6.2.2).

ExpiryStatus.title: ExpiryStatus
ExpiryStatus.description: The state of the expiry of a key as of today, the same names for every key (R6.2.2).

FlowChannelRequest.title: FlowChannelRequest
FlowChannelRequest.description: The channels of a flow for the type of event of the path, none for no notification.

FlowChannelsResponse.title: FlowChannelsResponse
FlowChannelsResponse.description: A flow of the tenant with its exceptions; an event without one follows the general choice.

FlowCreationRequest.title: FlowCreationRequest
FlowCreationRequest.description: A missing name, model, asset or risk limit arrives empty, so the domain answers with the reason (R1.1.1).

FlowEmergencyOutcomeResponse.title: FlowEmergencyOutcomeResponse
FlowEmergencyOutcomeResponse.description:
What the closing did to one flow: the assets closed, the positions left open with the reason of the exchange,
the reason the whole flow failed, or the remark that it had nothing to close (R3.2.3).

FlowEquityResponse.title: FlowEquityResponse
FlowEquityResponse.description:
The equity curve of a flow: a point for each cycle, from the oldest, and the capital it is judged against
(R2.2.3); amounts as text without trailing zeros (ADR 0018).

FlowForecastAccuracyResponse.title: FlowForecastAccuracyResponse
FlowForecastAccuracyResponse.description:
The error of the forecasts of a flow in the period, one for every asset and horizon it forecast (ADR
errore-medio-della-previsione-nell-api).

FlowModificationRequest.title: FlowModificationRequest
FlowModificationRequest.description:
Only the parts the user changes; the others keep the version in force (R1.1.3).

Account and allocated capital are taken by a draft (ADR bozza-configurata-dall-editor-e-duplica-con-conto); the
name by every flow not archived (ADR nome-del-flusso-modificabile).

FlowOverviewResponse.title: FlowOverviewResponse
FlowOverviewResponse.description:
A flow in use with its last cycle, the next planned one, the outcomes of its last ten cycles from the most
recent, how its capital is doing and its results in the period asked for (R1.7.3, R2.2.2, ADR 0127, R6.4.2).

FlowPositionResponse.title: FlowPositionResponse
FlowPositionResponse.description:
An open position of the flow (R1.6.1, R2.2.4) with its exit plan in force (R3.1.1); the percent is absent for a
position without margin, each level of the plan when the agent declared none.

FlowRankingResponse.title: FlowRankingResponse
FlowRankingResponse.description:
A row of the ranking of the flows (R2.4.2): amounts as text (ADR 0018), percentages with two decimals, null
when not available (ADR 0135).

FlowResponse.title: FlowResponse
FlowResponse.description: A flow with the configuration version in force; a draft may have no account, capital or assets (ADR 0124).

FlowResultsResponse.title: FlowResultsResponse
FlowResultsResponse.description:
How a flow is doing at a glance in the period asked for (R6.4.2, ADR riepilogo-dei-risultati-nell-api): gains
in the currency of the flow as text (ADR 0018), percents of the initial capital with two decimals, null without
initial capital; the next planned cycle, whatever the period, null unless the flow is active (R6.4.8).

FlowStateResponse.title: FlowStateResponse
FlowStateResponse.description:
The state of a flow attributed from the exchange at the request (R1.6.1), with its results in the period asked
for (R6.4.2) and why its openings are suspended, null when they are not (R3.3.2); amounts as strings (ADR 0018).

FlowStatisticsResponse.title: FlowStatisticsResponse
FlowStatisticsResponse.description:
The statistics of a flow over a period (R2.2.6): amounts as text (ADR 0018), win rate in percent with two
decimals, null when nothing is available (ADR 0122).

ForecastAccuracyResponse.title: ForecastAccuracyResponse
ForecastAccuracyResponse.description:
How much the forecasts of one asset and horizon missed in the period (R3.6.1): the mean absolute error as text
(ADR 0018), the mean percent error on the actual price with two decimals, null without evaluated forecasts.

FreeCapitalResponse.title: FreeCapitalResponse
FreeCapitalResponse.description:
The free capital of the account with the value and the result of its flows: the balance is the value of the flows
plus the free capital (ADR scomposizione-del-saldo-nel-riquadro-del-conto).

HistoryClosedPositionResponse.title: HistoryClosedPositionResponse
HistoryClosedPositionResponse.description: A closed position of the history, with its flow (R2.5.1).

HistoryClosedPositionsPageResponse.title: HistoryClosedPositionsPageResponse
HistoryClosedPositionsPageResponse.description:
At most 50 closed positions, newest close first; `next` is the `after` of the following page. `totals` comes
with the first page only, null on the following ones of the same search.

HistoryCycleResponse.title: HistoryCycleResponse
HistoryCycleResponse.description: A cycle of the history, with its flow and the configuration version in force when it ran (R2.5.1).

HistoryCyclesPageResponse.title: HistoryCyclesPageResponse
HistoryCyclesPageResponse.description: At most 50 cycles, newest first; `next` is the `after` of the following page, null on the last one.

HistoryOrderResponse.title: HistoryOrderResponse
HistoryOrderResponse.description: An order of the history with its outcome and its executions; `flow` is null for an order of no flow.

HistoryOrdersPageResponse.title: HistoryOrdersPageResponse
HistoryOrdersPageResponse.description:
At most 50 orders, newest first; `next` is the `after` of the following page, null on the last one. `totals`
comes with the first page only, null on the following ones of the same search.

InboxNotificationResponse.title: InboxNotificationResponse
InboxNotificationResponse.description:
A notification of the bell: its icon, title and values, when it was generated, when it was read, if it was, and
the pages it leads to, the first one where choosing it leads.

InboxPageResponse.title: InboxPageResponse
InboxPageResponse.description: At most 20 notifications, newest first; `next` is the `cursor` of the following page, null on the last one.

InboxTargetResponse.title: InboxTargetResponse
InboxTargetResponse.description:
A page the notification leads to, by what finds it: the flow and, for a position, its asset and the instant it
closed; or the alert it opened. The dashboard builds the address (ADR notifiche-nell-app-salvate-per-tenant).

KeyExpiryRequest.title: KeyExpiryRequest
KeyExpiryRequest.description: The day the user says a key stops working; none forgets it (R6.2.2).

KeyExpiryResponse.title: KeyExpiryResponse
KeyExpiryResponse.description: The day a key stops working, in UTC, and who gave it: `read` by the adapter, `entered` by the user (R6.2.2).

LastDecisionResponse.title: LastDecisionResponse
LastDecisionResponse.description:
The last decision of the agent in the flow: the planned instant of its cycle and its decisions, one by asset
(ADR decisioni-del-ciclo-registrate-per-asset).

LinkCodeResponse.title: LinkCodeResponse
LinkCodeResponse.description:
The code the user sends to the bot from the chat to link, until when it is valid, and the link that sends it
in one tap; no link while the bot is not active (R1.8.1).

LinkedChatResponse.title: LinkedChatResponse
LinkedChatResponse.description: Whether the tenant has a linked chat, and which one as Telegram numbers it, for the dashboard to show it.

MailSecurity.title: MailSecurity
MailSecurity.description:
How the connection to the mail server of the tenant is protected, by the words the user reads (R3.5.5): from the
first byte, or raised on the plain connection before the login.

MailServerRequest.title: MailServerRequest
MailServerRequest.description: The mail server the emails of the user leave from; a password left out keeps the saved one (R3.5.5).

MailServerResponse.title: MailServerResponse
MailServerResponse.description: The mail server of the user: never its password, only that one is saved (ADR server-di-posta-per-tenant).

ModelParameterResponse.title: ModelParameterResponse
ModelParameterResponse.description: A range has minimum and maximum, a choice its values; the default is always there.

NotificationChannelsResponse.title: NotificationChannelsResponse
NotificationChannelsResponse.description:
The choices of the user, every channel with its state and, whatever the choices, the warning of every channel
that cannot be reached (R3.5.5).

NotificationEmailRequest.title: NotificationEmailRequest
NotificationEmailRequest.description: The address the notifications go to by email; the platform checks its form (R3.5.2).

NotificationEmailResponse.title: NotificationEmailResponse
NotificationEmailResponse.description:
The address of the notifications by email, if any, and the warning that no email leaves when the tenant has
no mail server (R3.5.2, R3.5.5).

NotificationEvent.title: NotificationEvent
NotificationEvent.description:
The types of event told to the user, by the name the user chooses their channels by (R1.8.2, R3.5.1, R3.5.3).

An event belongs to a flow, or to the account when no single flow explains it.

OpeningsResume.title: OpeningsResume
OpeningsResume.description:
How the openings of a flow suspended for maximum loss resume (R3.2.2).

By hand unless the user chooses otherwise: the openings resume when the user confirms. The next day they resume on
their own at 00:00 UTC of the day after the suspension, and the user may still confirm before.

OpeningsSuspensionCause.title: OpeningsSuspensionCause
OpeningsSuspensionCause.description:
Why the openings of a flow are suspended: a maximum loss passed (R3.2.2) or an alarm of reconciliation open on
its account (R3.3.1). Only the first one the user resumes from the flow; the second ends with the confirmation of
the account.

OpeningsSuspensionResponse.title: OpeningsSuspensionResponse
OpeningsSuspensionResponse.description:
The openings of a flow suspended: the reason, since when, the cause and whether the user resumes them from the
flow, true only after a maximum loss (R3.2.2, R3.3.1).

OperationResponse.title: OperationResponse
OperationResponse.description:
A row of the ledger (ADR 0063, ADR 0074): amounts as text without trailing zeros (ADR 0047).

An execution has side, size and price; a funding payment has the amount paid (positive when received). `flow` is
the name of the flow of the row, null when it belongs to no flow (ADR 0080).

OperationsPageResponse.title: OperationsPageResponse
OperationsPageResponse.description: At most 50 rows, newest first; `next` is the `after` of the following page, null on the last one.

OperationsTotalsResponse.title: OperationsTotalsResponse
OperationsTotalsResponse.description: The totals of every row of the filter, not only of the page (ADR 0080).

OrderExecutionResponse.title: OrderExecutionResponse
OrderExecutionResponse.description: An execution of an order: price, quantity and fee as text without trailing zeros (ADR 0018).

OrderOutcomeResponse.title: OrderOutcomeResponse
OrderOutcomeResponse.description: The outcome of an order as the exchange gave it: the same body from worker and API (ADR 0023).

OrderTotalsResponse.title: OrderTotalsResponse
OrderTotalsResponse.description: The fees of the executions of every order of the filters, not only of the page (Bug 569).

PromptPlaceholderResponse.title: PromptPlaceholderResponse
PromptPlaceholderResponse.description: A placeholder the system prompt may use, with what it stands for (R1.4.8).

ProviderKeyResponse.title: ProviderKeyResponse
ProviderKeyResponse.description: A registered key as its owner reads it: the provider and when it was saved, never the key (R1.4.1, ADR 0130).

ProviderKeySummaryResponse.title: ProviderKeySummaryResponse
ProviderKeySummaryResponse.description:
A key on the page of the keys: the expiry as of today, with its state (`unknown`, `valid`, `expiring` within 30
days, `expired`) and the days left, and whether the user may give it (R6.2.2).

ReconciliationAlarmResponse.title: ReconciliationAlarmResponse
ReconciliationAlarmResponse.description: An alarm on the balance of the account: open until confirmed (R3.3.1).

SourceAdapterResponse.title: SourceAdapterResponse
SourceAdapterResponse.description:
An adapter of a source as it declares itself: no configuration field means no configuration needed (R4.1.1).

One that needs configuration says whether the tenant gave it and, when not, why it is not activatable (R4.1.2).

SourceCredentialsResponse.title: SourceCredentialsResponse
SourceCredentialsResponse.description:
An adapter that needs configuration on the page of the keys: the sources it offers, the fields it declares,
whether the tenant configured it, the values that are not secret and when they were saved, the expiry as of today
and whether the provider refused the credentials; never a secret (R4.1.2, R6.2.2).

SourceSelectionRequest.title: SourceSelectionRequest
SourceSelectionRequest.description: An active source with the adapters chosen: none is refused with the reason (R4.1.1).

SourceTrialRequest.title: SourceTrialRequest
SourceTrialRequest.description: The asset, only for a per-asset source, and the parameters the user set: the others take their default.

SourceTrialResponse.title: SourceTrialResponse
SourceTrialResponse.description: What the adapter answered the trial: a source that fails is the outcome, not an error of the request (R6.3.1).

StopOutcomeResponse.title: StopOutcomeResponse
StopOutcomeResponse.description: The flow stopped and the positions the exchange did not close, each with its reason (R1.1.5).

StrategyBody-Input.title: StrategyBody
StrategyBody-Input.description:
What a flow does, without account, capital, assets, keys or cycles (R2.5.2).

A missing model or limit arrives empty, so the domain answers with the reason.

StrategyBody-Output.title: StrategyBody
StrategyBody-Output.description:
What a flow does, without account, capital, assets, keys or cycles (R2.5.2).

A missing model or limit arrives empty, so the domain answers with the reason.

StrategyDocument-Input.title: StrategyDocument
StrategyDocument-Input.description: The strategy file: its format and version, so a file of another kind or of a later version is recognized.

StrategyDocument-Output.title: StrategyDocument
StrategyDocument-Output.description: The strategy file: its format and version, so a file of another kind or of a later version is recognized.

StrategySource.title: StrategySource
StrategySource.description: A source with the adapters the strategy chose (R4.1.1).

StrategySourceBeforeTheAdapters.title: StrategySourceBeforeTheAdapters
StrategySourceBeforeTheAdapters.description: A source of a file of the first version: its weight and parameters pass to the adapter it became.

TargetKind.title: TargetKind
TargetKind.description: What a notification leads to: a flow, one of its positions, open or closed, or the alert it opened.

UnattributablePageResponse.title: UnattributablePageResponse
UnattributablePageResponse.description:
At most 50 cases, newest first; `next` is the `cursor` of the following page, null on the last one. `count` and
`net_change`, the net of the changes of the balance, cover every case of the filter, not only the page.

UnattributableResponse.title: UnattributableResponse
UnattributableResponse.description:
A case no flow explains (R1.6.2): the change of the balance, or the size of a position or an execution, as text
without trailing zeros (ADR 0047).

VerificationRunResponse.title: VerificationRunResponse
VerificationRunResponse.description: A run of the procedure with the outcome of each step: the same body from worker and API (ADR 0024).

VersionResponse.title: VersionResponse
VersionResponse.description: One configuration version of a flow in the list: its number and when it was saved (R2.3.5).
